name: RedBlue
source:
Youko was going to enjoy her summer vacation, but instead, she's stuck taking supplementary lessons. One day, while on the way back home, she feels the heat getting to her, so she stops at a park to rest. This is a story about her and the guy she meets there.

[Translated from [url=http://lllakolll.xxxxxxxx.jp/RedBlue/redblue.html]official website[/url]]
